prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Mireth Lune. Character visual motifs: austere one-tailed fox archivist in deep blue-gray traveling robes with glass route tablets; no alluring charm trope.
TOP LEFT: Witness Marks. Ability concept: after an enemy moves 70 GU while visible to Mireth, records its heading as a glowing arrow for 3 s, once per enemy / 6 s.
TOP RIGHT: Counterpath. Ability concept: draws a short luminous road across an observed heading. Crossing it in the recorded direction costs 25% move speed for 1 s; crossing opposite grants no penalty. Can be skirted.
BOTTOM LEFT: False Exit. Ability concept: places a glass doorway that visually points to safety but openly projects its **actual** exit 75 GU to one side. The first enemy who voluntarily enters is displaced to that endpoint after 0.35 s. Enemy sees both endpoints before entering; no forced input manipulation.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Map of Might-Have-Beens. Ability concept: shows up to three recorded headings as public spectral roads for 4 s; allies gain speed while traversing them opposite the recorded direction, and foes crossing in the old direction receive a short revealed/exposed mark. No auto charm, orb return, or dash chain.
